notes.subject: min bɛ (that which has)
notes.rationale: Hebrew gives only four participles — bruised, crushed, torn, cut — with no stated body part; subject supplied.

notes.subject: balo-nu (testicles)
notes.rationale: Context (emasculated animals, cf. Lev 22:20 'stones' in ASV/JPS) supplies the referent the Hebrew leaves implicit.

notes.subject: Isirayeli
notes.rationale: Double prohibition addressed to the whole community, extending beyond the sanctuary into the land.

translation: Min bɛ mɛkɛtɔrɔ, walima min ɲagayara, walima min bɔra, walima min beena — aw kana o bɔ Yawe ma; aw ka dugukolo kɔnɔ fana, aw kana o kɛ.
